title: fix(plugin-grid): the bulk confirm sentence formats numbers and dates in the display locale
body:
Fixes #26307

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

A bulk action's confirm sentence formatted its numbers and dates in `en-US` for every viewer, while the same action's single-record confirm formats them in the viewer's language since PR #26282. `BulkActionDialog` called `bulkConfirmText(def.confirmText, { count, params, values, lookupLabels })` with no locale, so `fillTemplateHoles` fell back to `en-US`.

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`: reads `useDisplayLocale()` from `@object-ui/i18n`, the same hook the console's action runners install (`useActionRunnerDisplayLocale` in `ui/packages/react/src/context/actionRunnerTranslator.ts`), and passes it to `bulkConfirmText`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/bulkConfirmText.ts`: `bulkConfirmText(confirmText, scope, locale?)` hands `locale` to `fillTemplateHoles`'s third parameter, the locale channel apart from the template roots, so a param named `locale` stays a value the sentence prints. No second locale resolution: with no locale handed, the engine keeps `en-US`.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/plugin-grid.json`: re-recorded with `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` under the verify lock, on the tree after merging `origin/main` (PR #26323 had moved the same record; main's record was taken at the merge, then re-recorded). Only plugin-grid's sources digest moved; the artefact did not (`manifestSha256` unchanged). `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.
- `.changeset/26307-bulk-confirm-locale.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.

## Red first

New pin `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkConfirmLocale-26307.test.tsx`: the helper over `de-DE` and `zh-CN`, and the real `BulkActionDialog` under a real `I18nProvider` + `LocalizationProvider`. Expected strings are computed with `Intl` in the test, so a newer ICU cannot drift them.

Red leg: the two source files restored to `a70aa00b` (the unfixed base versions) in the working tree only, at head `64e9dbc5`, under the verify lock:

```text
× formats a currency, a number and a date hole in a German display locale
    Expected: "Set 1.234.567,50 € on 2 records?"   Received: "Set €1,234,567.50 on 2 records?"
× formats a date hole in a Chinese display locale
    Expected: "Due 2026年10月26日?"                 Received: "Due October 26, 2026?"
× formats a currency hole in the tenant display locale   (BulkActionDialog)
    Expected: "Set the amount to 1.234.567,50 € on 2 records?"   Received: "Set the amount to €1,234,567.50 on 2 records?"
Tests  3 failed | 2 passed (5)
```

The two passing cases are the `en-US` ones (no locale handed; no tenant locale under an English UI), which hold before and after. Restored from `HEAD` (blob hashes compared, `git diff HEAD` empty), green leg: `Tests 5 passed (5)`.

## Tests and gates

- Pin, at head `64e9dbc5`: red 3 failed / 2 passed, then green 5 / 5 (above).
- Full plugin-grid suite, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid --maxWorkers=2` from `ui/`, under the lock at `e42274e0` (the merge; same sources as `64e9dbc5`, which changes only the pin's matcher): 251 of 252 files, 2251 of 2252 tests passed. The one failure was this pin's dialog case matching with `findByText`, whose normaliser turns the no-break space `Intl` writes before a de-DE `€` into a plain space in the node text but not in the matcher string; `64e9dbc5` reads the dialog description's `textContent` instead, and the pin is 5 / 5 at that head.
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0 at `e42274e0`.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0 at `e42274e0` after the re-record.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, head `64e9dbc5`): 45 derived; 44 run, each exit 0; `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it was queued on the shared verify lock for its closure build), so NOT MEASURED locally, and CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it. `--ran` reconciliation: "45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 44 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)", 0 UNRUN.
- The derivation warned that the tree is 5 commits behind `origin/main` (3 gate scripts changed across that range). Main was merged once before opening, as required; it is not merged again unless a conflict, a main-caused red or a queue removal calls for it.

## Acceptance notes

- `useDisplayLocale()` with no providers mounted resolves `en`, so every existing bulk dialog suite (rendered without providers) keeps its `en-US` sentences; the full plugin-grid run above confirms it.
